christians-reading-classics.title: Staying Sober: The Healing Power of Classic Books, with Ken Craycraft
christians-reading-classics.description: “One drink is too many, and a hundred is not enough.” Charles Jackson’s The Lost Weekend gave the world that line, and moral theologian Dr. Kenneth Craycraft knows its truth firsthand. Now more than two decades sober, Kenneth joins Nadya to talk about four classic novels about alcoholism: The Lost Weekend , Brideshead Revisited , Under the Volcano , and The Edge of Sadness . He explains how their deceiving, bargaining, and recovering drinkers helped him tell the truth about his own life. Dr. Craycraft is professor of moral theology at Mount St. Mary’s Seminary and School of Theology in Cincinnati and the author of Staying Sober One Story at a Time.
